title: UI/UX Designer Intern
description:
**Location:** In\-office \- Bangalore (full\-time, on\-site)

**Role:** UI/UX Designer

**Type:** Full\-time

**About Zenalyst**Zenalyst builds an enterprise agentic execution layer for the CFO's office — treasury, procure\-to\-pay, and collections automation for large organizations.We are building AI\-powered solutions that simplify complex financial workflows and help enterprises make faster, more informed decisions. As we continue to build and grow our brand, design plays an important role in how we communicate our products, technology, and vision to customers and the broader market.

This is a hands\-on creative role in a fast\-moving AI fintech environment, where you will collaborate closely with marketing, product, and business teams and have the opportunity to influence how the company and its products are presented to customers and the broader market.

**Role Description :**This is a full\-time on\-site role for a UI/UX Designer located in Bangalore, primarily supporting the marketing and brand initiatives at Zenalyst.ai. The role involves creating high\-quality visual content across presentations, social media, marketing campaigns, videos, and other digital and print assets. The designer will work closely with the marketing and business teams to develop creative content that communicates the company's brand, products, and ideas effectively.

**What You'll Do :**

* Design PPT presentations, pitch decks, business presentations, and other presentation materials
* Create social media creatives, posters, banners, carousels, infographics, and marketing collateral
* Create and edit videos, reels, promotional videos, product videos, and other visual content
* Develop creative concepts and visual content for marketing campaigns, events, announcements, and brand initiatives
* Design engaging content for social media platforms and other digital channels
* Create visual assets for website, email campaigns, blogs, newsletters, and other marketing activities
* Translate complex AI, financial, and technology concepts into simple and engaging visual content
* Maintain consistency across all marketing and brand assets in line with the company's visual identity
* Collaborate with the marketing team to understand campaign objectives and develop creative concepts accordingly
* Work with product and business teams when design support is required for product\-related or business initiatives
* Edit and refine designs, presentations, and videos based on stakeholder feedback
* Maintain and organize reusable design templates, assets, and brand materials
* Stay updated with current design, social media, presentation, and visual content trends
* Manage multiple creative projects simultaneously and deliver high\-quality work within timelines

**What We're Looking For :**

* Strong understanding of visual design, graphic design, and UI/UX principles
* Proficiency in Figma, Canva, PowerPoint, and other relevant design tools
* Strong skills in presentation design and visual storytelling
* Experience creating posters, banners, carousels, social media creatives, and marketing collateral
* Experience with video editing and visual content creation
* Strong understanding of typography, colors, layouts, composition, and visual hierarchy
* Creative mindset with strong attention to detail
* Ability to understand a brief and translate it into compelling visual content
* Ability to maintain consistency with brand guidelines and visual identity
* Good communication and collaboration skills

**Tools :**

* Figma
* Canva
* PowerPoint
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Adobe After Effects

**Why Zenalyst.ai ?**

* Work on the visual identity and marketing presence of a growing AI fintech company
* Create content across social media, presentations, campaigns, videos, branding, and digital marketing
* Work on complex AI and financial concepts and turn them into engaging visual experiences
* Collaborate directly with marketing, product, business, and leadership teams
* Take ownership of a wide range of creative projects in a fast\-paced startup environment
* Be part of a growing AI\-powered financial intelligence company

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Interior Designer
description:
Here is a comprehensive Job Description tailored specifically for **Niell Designs**, highlighting your focus on high\-end customized wooden, engineered, and stainless steel modular solutions.  
Job Title: Senior Interior Designer – Modular Kitchens \& Wardrobes**Company:** Niell Designs  
**Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience Level:** 2–5 Years  
About Niell DesignsAt **Niell Designs**, we specialize in premium modular kitchens, wardrobes, and customized storage solutions that combine architectural elegance with precision engineering. Our portfolio spans high\-grade wooden and plywood systems (BWP/BHR), stainless steel 304/GI solutions, and luxury finishes like acrylic, PU, and European laminates integrated with world\-class hardware. We are looking for a passionate, detail\-oriented Interior Designer to join our team and translate client visions into functional, beautifully engineered living spaces.  
Key Responsibilities1\. Design \& Client Consultation

* Conduct in\-depth design consultations with residential clients, architects, and interior consultants to understand spatial needs, aesthetic preferences, and budget constraints.
* Conceptualize and draft functional, ergonomically optimized layouts for modular kitchens, bedroom wardrobes, walk\-in closets, and custom storage units.
* Guide clients through material selections, highlighting the benefits of solid wood, marine\-grade plywood (BWP), stainless steel 304, GI powder\-coated carcasses, acrylics, PU finishes, and high\-end hardware systems.

2\. Technical Drawings \& Detailing

* Create detailed 2D production drawings, elevation layouts, floor plans, and section drawings using AutoCAD.
* Develop realistic 3D visualizations, renderings, and walk\-throughs using SketchUp / 3ds Max / Google SketchUp / Enscape or equivalent rendering tools.
* Generate precise Bill of Quantities (BOQ), material specifications, quotation estimates, and production\-ready cutting lists for factory fabrication.

3\. Site Evaluation \& Execution Support

* Conduct precise on\-site measurements and technical site audits prior to design finalization (checking plumbing, electrical points, wall plumb, and civil constraints).
* Coordinate closely with factory production teams, carpenters, and fitment specialists to ensure design feasibility and seamless manufacturing.
* Perform periodic site visits during installation to resolve technical discrepancies, oversee quality control, and ensure flawless handover.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:** 2\+ years of hands\-on experience exclusively in modular kitchen and bedroom furniture design.
* **Technical Software Proficiency:**
* 2D CAD drafting: **AutoCAD**
* 3D Modeling \& Rendering: **SketchUp**, **3ds Max**, **V\-Ray / Enscape**, or dedicated modular software (e.g., KDMax, Cabinet Vision).
* **Material \& Hardware Expertise:**
* Deep knowledge of wood materials (BWP/BWR Plywood, MDF, HDF\-HMR, Solid Wood) and sheet finishes (Laminates, Acrylics, PU, Veneer).
* Understanding of **Stainless Steel 304 / GI modular carcass construction** and hybrid wood\-metal joinery details.
* In\-depth understanding of architectural hardware brands (Blum, Hettich, Hafele, Grass, Geze, etc.).

Key Competencies \& Personal Attributes

* Strong aesthetic sense paired with practical technical execution knowledge.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills to confidently pitch design concepts to high\-net\-worth clients.
* High attention to detail regarding millimeter\-level accuracy in modular design and site measurements.
* Ability to handle multiple client projects simultaneously from initial lead stage through final handover.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary package with performance\-linked incentives per project close out.
* Exposure to luxury materials, advanced hybrid (stainless steel \+ wood) modular technology, and high\-end residential projects.
* Collaborative environment working alongside experienced manufacturing and engineering specialists.

How to ApplyInterested candidates are invited to submit their **Resume** and **Portfolio (featuring modular kitchen \& wardrobe projects)** to **careers.niell@gmail.com**

Pay: From ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: UX Designer
description:
India \- Bangalore


Professional Services/Full time/Onsite

  



Guidewire’s Professional Services (PS) team partners with P\&C insurers worldwide to implement our cloud platform and unlock measurable value from their transformation programs.  

  

You’ll join a multidisciplinary UX group within PS that collaborates closely with product development, architects, and delivery teams to design intuitive, high\-performing digital experiences for complex insurance workflows.  

  

We work in a supportive, in‑person environment in Bengaluru, combining design craft, domain expertise, and curiosity to solve real customer problems.  

In this role, you will design responsive user interfaces for enterprise insurance applications, integrating cutting\-edge AI capabilities into day\-to\-day workflows for claims, policy, billing, and analytics. You’ll apply a user\-centered design process to translate intricate business and technical constraints into clear, scalable interaction patterns and visual systems, collaborating with BAs, engineers, and client stakeholders. This is an opportunity to deepen your craft, shape PS delivery assets, and directly influence how insurers engage, operate, and make decisions on Guidewire’s global industry platform.


**Job Description**

**What you’ll do**

  

* Collaborate with Lead UX Architects, Business Analysts, and engineers to design end‑to‑end UX and UI flows for complex insurance journeys (e.g., claims, policy servicing, billing) that are both user\-centered and technically feasible.
* Create high\-quality, responsive UI designs, wireframes, and interactive prototypes in Figma, ensuring they align with customer brand guidelines, PS implementation accelerators, and Guidewire’s design system and tokens.
* Translate business requirements, user research, and workflow analysis into clear UX deliverables (journey maps, information architecture, interaction patterns, high‑fidelity mockups, and redlines) that support faster, higher‑quality Professional Services implementations and reusable assets.
* Partner with PS project teams in an Agile/Scrum environment to refine designs through sprint ceremonies, incorporate feedback from client stakeholders, and balance usability, performance, accessibility, and delivery timelines.

Contribute to the evolution of * d design systems, design tokens, and component libraries used across PS to reduce implementation effort, improve consistency, and scale best\-practice user experience patterns across regions and lines of business.
* Apply accessibility and inclusive design principles to ensure solutions work for diverse users, devices, and usage contexts, helping insurers deliver compliant, intuitive digital products for their customers and employees.
* Use AI‑powered design, prototyping, and analytics tools where appropriate to explore concepts, validate ideas quickly, and improve design productivity in line with Guidewire’s AI‑driven services strategy and cloud transformation priorities.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data\-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

 **What you’ll bring**

**Required**


Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data\-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.

* 3\-6 years of experience in UX, interaction, or UI design, ideally on complex enterprise, B2B, or workflow\-heavy software products or platforms.
* Proficiency with modern design and collaboration tools such as Figma and Miro; familiarity with tools like Photoshop and PowerPoint for visual refinement, stakeholder presentations, and design documentation.
* Experience working with or contributing to design systems and design tokens, and confidence designing responsive web applications for desktop and mobile.
* Strong visual and interaction design skills, with keen attention to detail in layout, spacing, typography, color, component states, and error handling.
* Ability to work independently under the guidance of a Lead UX Architect while actively collaborating with cross\-functional Agile/Scrum teams in a fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions to non\-design stakeholders, facilitate feedback sessions, and iterate quickly based on input.
* Solid organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and project streams, including client\-driven priorities and internal PS initiatives.

 **Preferred**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human\-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, UX Design, Industrial Design, Design Thinking, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience designing for insurance, financial services, or other regulated, domain\-heavy industries where workflows are complex and data\-rich.
* Exposure to Professional Services or implementation projects (for example, working with external client stakeholders, adapting designs to customer\-specific brands and processes, or supporting product rollouts).
* Understanding of how AI and analytics can be embedded into workflows (such as assisting adjusters, underwriters, contact\-center agents, or operations teams) to improve decision\-making, efficiency, and customer experience.

 **Your Impact**


We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first months, you’ll onboard to Guidewire’s products, Professional Services methods, and core P\&C insurance journeys, then take ownership of UX and UI design for specific features or projects under the mentorship of a Lead UX Architect and senior PS leaders.

  

You’ll help create Figma\-based design assets, specifications, and reusable patterns that reduce implementation effort and time while elevating user experience across customer programs and regions. As you grow, your work will shape how PS scales AI\-enabled delivery, influences product and design system evolution, and helps global insurers successfully run, differentiate, and grow their businesses on Guidewire’s cloud, digital, analytics, and AI\-powered industry platform.

  

Interested in this position?


  
**About Guidewire**


Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.


As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.


For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.


Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

title: Designer, Brand & Communications
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.


Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.


About Candescent


Candescent is the leading cloud\-based digital banking solutions provider for financial institutions. We are transforming digital banking with intelligent, cloud\-powered solutions that connect account opening, digital banking, and branch experiences for financial institutions. Our advanced technology and developer tools enable seamless, differentiated customer journeys that elevate trust, service, and innovation.


Success here requires flexibility in a fast\-paced environment, a client\-first mindset, and a commitment to delivering consistent, reliable results as part of a performance\-driven, value\-led team. With team members around the world, Candescent is an equal opportunity employer.

**Designer, Brand \& Communications**
=====================================

*A hands\-on design role supporting Candescent’s global Brand \& Communications team. Multiple openings.*

**Business Function:**


Brand \& Communications

**Location:**


India office \- Bengaluru\| Hybrid

**Type:**


Full\-time

**Job Summary**
---------------

*Role Purpose*


Candescent is seeking talented Designers to join our Brand \& Communications team from one of our India office locations. This role will help bring the Candescent brand to life across internal, client\-facing, executive, event, digital, social, and sales enablement materials. The ideal candidate combines strong design craft, production discipline, and brand stewardship with the ability to move quickly across a wide range of requests.


This is a hands\-on design role. You will personally create, refine, and finalize high\-quality work while partnering closely with brand, communications, marketing, product marketing, sales, and events stakeholders. Success requires strong typography and layout skills, comfort with content\-heavy materials, and the ability to maintain a consistent visual standard across every touchpoint.


We have several openings and welcome designers with a range of strengths across brand, presentation, digital, print, and video.

**Key Responsibilities and Deliverables**
-----------------------------------------

*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*

### **Brand Design \& Visual Execution**

* Create polished visual solutions across digital, print, presentation, event, social, sales enablement, and internal communications projects.
* Design a wide range of assets including presentations, sales and marketing decks, one\-pagers, ebooks, infographics, newsletters, social graphics, event materials, signage, and internal communications visuals.
* Translate complex, content\-heavy, or abstract information into clear, engaging, and visually compelling communications.
* Elevate layouts, typography, hierarchy, imagery, icons, charts, and data visualizations so materials are easy to understand and unmistakably on brand.

### **Brand Consistency \& Design Systems**

* Apply Candescent brand standards across all assigned work, including typography, colour, layout, iconography, imagery, motion, and data visualization.
* Use established templates and systems appropriately, while identifying opportunities to improve usability, scalability, and consistency.
* Spot and correct brand drift, formatting inconsistencies, visual clutter, and production issues before materials are delivered.

### **Production, Quality Control \& Delivery**

* Prepare accurate, production\-ready files for digital, print, presentation, video, large\-format, and event applications.
* Proof work carefully for alignment, spacing, hierarchy, accuracy, export settings, image and audio quality, and brand compliance.
* Manage multiple projects and deadlines at once while maintaining a high standard of craft and attention to detail.
* Respond quickly to feedback, incorporate revisions thoughtfully, and deliver final assets that require minimal rework.

### **Collaboration \& Ways of Working**

* Partner with team members and cross\-functional stakeholders to clarify objectives, understand audiences, and translate business needs into effective visual communications.
* Work closely with the senior design lead in India, who will set priorities, review work, and provide creative direction and coaching.
* Collaborate with US\-based stakeholders through clear communication, organised handoffs, and reliable follow\-through.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.

**Experience**
--------------

*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*

* 4–6 years of professional graphic design experience, preferably within an in\-house creative team, agency, corporate brand team, B2B, fintech, SaaS, or enterprise environment.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating high\-quality design execution across presentations, digital, print, social, or brand storytelling materials.
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop.
* Working proficiency in PowerPoint for presentation design, including slide systems, templates, charts, and diagrams.
* Strong typography, layout, composition, and information design skills, with a solid understanding of brand systems and how to apply them consistently across channels and formats.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects, adapt to shifting priorities, and deliver high\-quality work on deadline.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions clearly and professionally.

**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
--------------------------------------------

*Additional accomplishments*

* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design, Fine Arts, Film, Animation, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio may be considered in lieu of a formal degree.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience designing for executive, client, partner, or sales audiences is preferred.
* Familiarity with Figma for digital and collaborative design work is preferred.
* Production knowledge including file preparation, print production, vendor coordination, and large\-format applications is a plus.
* Experience with illustration, photography, or audio editing is a plus.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Brand and communications materials are polished, consistent, accurate, and recognisably Candescent across every touchpoint.
* Executive, client\-facing, sales, and internal materials are visually clear, easy to follow, and delivered with a high level of craft.
* Work is delivered on time and to a high standard, with minimal rework required.
* Templates, systems, and recurring materials become easier to use, more consistent, and faster to produce over time.
* Stakeholders receive thoughtful design partnership, clear communication, and reliable delivery.

**What Will Make You Successful**
---------------------------------

* Strong visual judgment, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to design craftsmanship.
* Ability to produce polished, production\-ready work with moderate direction.
* Comfort moving quickly between projects and formats while maintaining a consistently high quality bar.
* Curiosity and willingness to develop new skills as the team’s needs evolve.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.

**Portfolio Submission**
------------------------

*Required with every application*


A portfolio is mandatory for consideration. Applications submitted without a portfolio link or PDF will not be reviewed. Please include a link to an online portfolio or an attached PDF, with access credentials if the work is password protected, along with three to five selected pieces that best demonstrate your design craft and a short note on your specific contribution to each.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**  

To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior Designer - Design Validation
description:
Senior Designer \- Design Validation
Bengaluru, Karnataka
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Senior Designer plays a critical role in ensuring that design outputs meet high\-quality standards and align with project objectives and customer needs. This position requires a strong understanding of design validation principles and collaboration with various stakeholders to refine and implement effective design solutions.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Collaborate With Stakeholders To Gather And Articulate Design Requirements, Ensuring Clarity And Alignment With Project Objectives And Customer Expectations.
  

2\. Develop Interactive Prototypes And Proof\-Of\-Concept Implementations Using Design Tools Such As Sketch And Invision To Validate Design Concepts And Decision\-Making.
  

3\. Mentor And Guide Junior Designers By Sharing Knowledge And Expertise Through Training Sessions, Workshops, And Comprehensive Documentation.
  

4\. Work Alongside Cross\-Functional Teams, Including Developers And Product Managers, To Ensure Software Design Integrates Seamlessly With Overall Project Goals And User Experience.

5\. Basic Understanding Of Front\-End Development Technologies To Communicate Effectively With Development Teams.
**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Optional But Valuable: Certified Usability Analyst (Cua) Or Other Relevant Design Certifications.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Antique Network Solution Pvt. Ltd. (Chitchaat)

Bengaluru (JP Nagar Phase 1\) \| Full\-time, Work from Office

Website: https://chitchaat.biz/

About Chitchaat

Chitchaat is a leading multichannel messaging engagement platform that enables businesses to connect with customers across SMS, WhatsApp, Email, Voice, RCS, and more. Through automation, analytics, AI\-powered workflows, and seamless API integrations, we help brands deliver meaningful customer experiences at scale.

Role Overview

As a UI/UX Designer at Chitchaat, you will be responsible for designing intuitive, scalable, and visually compelling experiences across our platform. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Business Stakeholders to transform complex messaging workflows into simple and engaging user experiences.

You will play a key role in defining user journeys, improving usability, building design systems, and creating high\-quality interfaces for dashboards, campaign management tools, analytics modules, chat applications, and customer engagement workflows.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the end\-to\-end design process from discovery and research through wireframing, prototyping, visual design, testing, and implementation.
* Design intuitive user experiences for messaging workflows across WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Voice, RCS, and emerging communication channels.
* Create user flows, information architecture, wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes.
* Conduct user research, stakeholder interviews, usability testing, and competitor analysis to identify opportunities for product improvement.
* Design dashboards, reporting interfaces, campaign builders, chatbot management tools, and customer engagement workflows.
* Establish and maintain scalable design systems, component libraries, and UI standards.
* Work closely with frontend developers to ensure pixel\-perfect implementation and consistent user experiences.
* Collaborate with Product Managers to translate business requirements into elegant design solutions.
* Analyze user behavior and feedback to continuously improve usability and engagement.
* Advocate for accessibility, responsive design, and UX best practices across all products.
* Contribute to product strategy discussions and help define the future user experience vision for Chitchaat.

Must\-Have Skills

* 3–5\+ years of experience in UI/UX, Product Design, or related design roles.
* Strong expertise in Figma for wireframing, prototyping, design systems, and collaboration.
* Proven experience designing complex SaaS platforms, dashboards, workflow\-driven applications, or enterprise products.
* Strong understanding of user\-centered design principles and design thinking methodologies.
* Expertise in creating user journeys, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs.
* Strong visual design skills, including typography, color theory, spacing, layout systems, and interaction design.
* Experience conducting user research, usability testing, and translating findings into actionable improvements.
* Understanding of responsive design principles across desktop, tablet, and mobile platforms.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and understand frontend implementation constraints.
* Experience maintaining and evolving design systems and component libraries.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills

* Experience designing communication, messaging, CRM, marketing automation, SaaS, or customer engagement platforms.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, and frontend development concepts.
* Experience working with analytics\-heavy products and data visualization best practices.
* Understanding of AI\-assisted user experiences, chatbots, and conversational design.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Familiarity with Azure Boards, Jira, or similar project management tools.
* Experience using AI\-powered design and productivity tools.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), Fine Arts, Psychology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong portfolio showcasing end\-to\-end product design work across web and mobile platforms.
* Experience designing SaaS, enterprise, B2B, or workflow\-oriented products is highly preferred.

Why Join Us?

* Design products used by businesses to engage millions of customers across multiple communication channels.
* Influence the UX strategy and product direction of a rapidly growing SaaS platform.
* Work on real\-time messaging interfaces, analytics dashboards, automation workflows, and AI\-powered customer engagement tools.
* Collaborate with a highly talented product and engineering team.
* Opportunity to grow into Senior Product Designer, Lead Designer, or Head of Design roles.

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.



Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.



Visit gomotive.com to learn more.


We're looking for a Senior Manager of Product Design to lead our new Maintenance and Fuel vertical and grow our design presence in Bangalore. This role is both hands\-on and organizationally pivotal. You will lead a team of designers working within our growing Maintenance and Fuel vertical, delivering intuitive, scalable experiences across web and mobile platforms.



In parallel, you will serve as a local design leader for South Asia, supporting and mentoring designers across teams, many of whom may report into different managers globally. You'll play a critical role in strengthening design culture on the ground, elevating craft, and ensuring designers in the region feel supported, connected, and set up to succeed. You will also be instrumental in building and scaling our design team in India, helping us attract and hire exceptional talent in a highly competitive market.



You will be pivotal in defining and executing the product strategy, working in close partnership with cross\-functional leaders to deliver exceptional and user\-centric experiences for fleet managers, drivers, and back\-office personnel.



As a design leader who remains highly connected to the craft, you will champion the growth and development of a talented team of designers through effective mentorship and coaching, fostering a high\-performance design culture. You will also be a key driver in the evolution and adoption of AI\-centric product development, ensuring a scalable, unified, and high\-quality user experience across our entire product ecosystem.



Reporting to our VP of Design, you will have the opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team to make a significant impact on our customers' lives and contribute directly to key business objectives. If you have a proven track record of successfully leading strategic design initiatives while remaining connected to the design process and tackling complex challenges, we encourage you to apply.


**What you'll do**


### **Product \& Design Leadership**


* Lead and support a team of designers contributing to our Maintenance \& Fuel domain.
* Drive high\-quality, user\-centered design solutions that simplify complex workflows for fleet managers, drivers, and operations teams.
* Partner with product and engineering to shape strategy, prioritize initiatives, and deliver impactful outcomes aligned with business goals.
* Own design execution end\-to\-end—from early framing and concepting through detailed design, validation, and iteration.
* Align teams around a shared vision through strong storytelling and strategic thinking and communicate design rationale clearly and persuasively to stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Contribute to and evolve our design system to ensure consistency, scalability, and efficiency across platforms.
* Champion the use of modern AI tools to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and delivery.
* Introduce and scale AI\-assisted workflows across design and cross\-functional teams.
* Stay at the forefront of emerging tools and practices, bringing new ideas into the organization.
* Advocate for design excellence and a user\-centric mindset across the organization.

### **Regional Leadership (South Asia)**


* Serve as the on\-the\-ground design leader in Bangalore, supporting designers across multiple teams in the region.
* Mentor and coach designers who may not directly report to you, helping elevate craft, execution quality, and career growth.
* Foster a strong, connected design culture in South Asia, including team rituals, critiques, and knowledge sharing.
* Act as a key connector between regional teams and global design leadership, ensuring alignment and strong collaboration.
* Build, mentor, and manage a high\-performing team of product designers based in Bangalore.
* Help establish Bangalore as a center of excellence for product design within the organization \- playing a hands\-on role in attracting, sourcing, hiring, interviewing, and closing top design talent in India.

**What you'll need**
--------------------


* 8–10\+ years of experience in product design (UX/UI/interaction), with experience managing and growing design teams in a SaaS environment.
* Proven track record designing complex, data\-rich web and mobile products, ideally in fleet management, logistics, or similarly complex domains.
* Experience working with distributed/global teams, with strong collaboration across time zones.
* Demonstrated success hiring and scaling design teams, ideally in India or similar markets.

* + End\-to\-end design thinking
	+ Systems\-level problem solving
	+ High\-quality execution
	+ Measurable business impact
* Deep experience with design systems and scaling them across products and teams.
* Hands\-on familiarity with modern AI tools and workflows, and a strong point of view on how they reshape design and product development.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence across disciplines.
* Strong business acumen and an understanding of how design drives product and company outcomes.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a bias toward action in a fast\-moving environment.
